Each of the four departures (WC21, WC06, WC11, WC01) is re-dated to 14:00 Tue 10 Nov with the reason, the entry keeping its id and units; WC67's added note gets the same day corrected to Wed 11 Nov. Applied only if the dry run shows the P&L unchanged.
